_comment: Single source of truth for model pricing. USD per 1M tokens, Amazon Bedrock on-demand, us-east-1 / US cross-region inference profiles (verified against Cost Explorer usage-type unit rates, 2026-09-03; Bedrock = Anthropic first-party +10%). Keys match gen_ai.request.model values seen in spans - both bare model names (Claude Code CLI) and Bedrock inference-profile ids (Strands personas). cachedInputDiscount = cache-read rate as a fraction of input. kiro.usdPerCredit converts Kiro credits (its only usage unit) to USD for cross-engine comparison.

kiro._basis: Kiro Pro $20/mo / 1000 credits (lowest public tier, per aws.amazon.com/q/developer/faqs); overage rate is $0.04/credit

agentcore._basis: AgentCore Runtime consumption pricing us-east-1, verified against Cost Explorer unit rates 2026-09
